name: Rotation gate
purpose: CI-time enforcer of the rotation-days budget declared on each manifest entry. Reads the manifest, queries the vendor for the current per-entry `lastRotatedAt`, fails the CI run on any expired or unknown-age entry, honours a bounded override, and audits the outcome.
responsibilities: Read the manifest through TAC-902 and iterate every entry with a `rotationDays` value (AC-8109-1).

For each entry and each configured target environment, query the vendor adapter for the current `lastRotatedAt`; compare the elapsed days against `rotationDays`; fail with `SECRETS_ROTATION_EXPIRED` when elapsed > budget (AC-8109-1).
Fail with `SECRETS_ROTATION_UNKNOWN` when the vendor returns no `lastRotatedAt` for an entry, regardless of `required` (AC-8109-2).

Load the operator-authored override file when present; for a named entry with an unexpired override, skip the fail and emit a `SECRETS_ROTATION_OVERRIDE_APPLIED` audit event carrying the override author, expiry, and the wall-clock at gate time (AC-8109-3).
Refuse to accept an override without an `expiresAt` timestamp; the override is bounded by design.
Emit a `--report` structured summary listing every entry's environment, `lastRotatedAt`, elapsed days, budget, and outcome; the report never contains a secret value.
internalStructure: One stateless command handler runnable from any CI runner. Composes TAC-902 (manifest), the vendor adapter from TAC-901, and a small override reader. Wall-clock injected for test surface.

interfaces.name: vendorAdapter
interfaces.description: The same vendor binding the Secrets Manager client uses (TAC-901), scoped to a rotation-metadata read (no value fetch is required for the gate's own operation).

interfaces.name: overrideStore
interfaces.description: Reads the operator-authored override file (project-authored path; a JSON or YAML file listing per-name `{ author, expiresAt, reason }` entries).

interfaces.name: clock
interfaces.description: Injectable millisecond wall clock for the elapsed-days arithmetic.

interfaces.name: auditSink
interfaces.description: The same sink shape TAC-901 uses; the gate emits override-applied and rotation-expired events through it.

dependencies.name: Secrets Manifest
dependencies.description: Source of the entries the gate iterates over.

dependencies.name: Secrets Manager client
dependencies.description: Provider of the vendor adapter shape the gate re-uses for the rotation-metadata query.

tradeoffs: The gate treats the vendor as the truth source for rotation age; a vendor with an unreliable `lastRotatedAt` field turns the gate into false positives. Projects on a vendor without native rotation metadata track rotation timestamps in a parallel side-file at the cost of an extra source of truth (accept the trade or supersede ADR-905 with a project-level ADR selecting a stricter posture).
